_note: Creature data (docs/06-creatures.md). Stats come from that doc. Move powers and how often each is picked are tuned against the table in docs/05-combat.md with `npm run sim`. Tougher groups double their drop chances; weaker groups (the south road) halve them. `sprites` are anim prefixes.

forParty._note: How foes grow with the heroes who start the fight: docs/05-combat.md. No single blow in such a fight takes more than blowCap of a hero's most health. Eldwin alone is untouched.

creatures.name: The Toll Goose
creatures._art: A big grey gander in Dorcas Brigham's hat (decision 0200). Beaten, the hat comes off (tollgoose_bare_side, tollgoose_hat_side) and he walks off the road.

creatures.name: Quillpig
creatures._art: A porcupine whose quills lie back, half rise for a shove, and stand straight up when hit or bristling; curls into a ball (decision 0202).

creatures.name: Whitecoat
creatures._art: A snowshoe hare, white already, black ear tips and big hind feet; kicks with both (decision 0202).

creatures.name: Old Tup
creatures._art: A ram left behind, gone half wild: matted fleece, curled horns; butts, and won’t budge (decision 0290). Can’t be muddled or flung clear (rules.ts startFoe).

creatures.name: Grit Swallow
creatures._art: A bank swallow from the quarry face, in the air the whole fight (decision 0290). Its flock brings a second swallow into the fight, once a caller (decision 0407).

creatures.name: Fisher
creatures._art: A fisher cat, long and low, all teeth and noise (decision 0290). Pounces on whoever is weakest.

creatures.name: Pewling
creatures._art: A skunk in the lilacs (decision 0290): stamps its warning, then turns about to spray.

creatures.name: The Pale Hart
creatures._art: A white stag from the cold side, frightened and very strong (decision 0290). Gathers itself and charges the wall every few rounds; frost rings off its antlers under half health. Beaten, it waits at the wall.

creatures.name: Applejack
creatures._art: A black bear drunk on windfall apples (decision 0290): sways, so his blows land on anyone; sits down hard every few rounds and dozes.

creatures.name: Whistlepig
creatures._art: Hardscrabble's whistlepig (decision 0330): the road's, fatter for winter, with its own level and numbers so it pays at 7 to 12. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Frostheave
creatures._art: Hardscrabble's frostheave (decision 0330): the road's, with its own level and numbers. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Whitecoat
creatures._art: Hardscrabble's whitecoat (decision 0330): the road's hare, with its own level and numbers. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Whitecoat
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's (decision 0434): the snowshoe hare from the cold side, tougher again for the North Lots at the region's levels; the same sheets as the Long Wall's and Hardscrabble's.

creatures.name: Quillpig
creatures._art: Hardscrabble's quillpig (decision 0330): the road's porcupine, with its own level and numbers. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Seam Rimeling
creatures._art: Rimelings grown in the Deep Cut's dark rock (decision 0330): the road's hoarling, bluer, no new art.

creatures.name: Barkling
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a rick of hemlock bark come loose and walking (decision 0422). Curls up tight when struck.

creatures.name: Fisher
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): Hardscrabble's fisher, tougher, with its own level and numbers. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Quillpig
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): the road's porcupine, tougher again. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Strutting Tom
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a wild turkey, fat on mast and furious about it (decision 0422). His gobble makes every blow come to him.

creatures.name: Chatterer
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a red squirrel, small, fast and very angry (decision 0422). Dodges; scolds a hero's guard open.

creatures.name: Whistlepig
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): the road's woodchuck, fat on mast. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Masked Bandit
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a raccoon in the night camp's food (decision 0423). Filches what a hero has going and eats it.

creatures.name: Hushwing
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): the barn owl from the Old Burying Ground, tougher. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Frostheave
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a ring-wall stone pushed up by frost, where the wall crosses the road. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Ledge Hawk
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a red-tailed hawk off the cliff (decision 0423). Its stoop comes out of the sky, past any wall.

creatures.name: Old Tup
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): Hardscrabble's ram, wilder for a summer on the high pastures. Same sheets; stubborn as ever.

creatures.name: Rattler
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a timber rattlesnake sunning on the ledge (decision 0423). Rattles a round before it strikes hard.

creatures.name: The Bull of the Woods
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a bull moose in the rut (decision 0424). Paws the ground a round before he charges; halfway down his antlers catch in a beech; beaten, he bellows and crashes off into the beeches.

creatures.name: The Catamount
creatures._art: The Tanbark Road's (decision 0429): a panther everyone says is long gone (decision 0424). Never where it was: it strikes from out of sight and shows only the round after. Settled, it slips over the ring wall onto the cold side.

creatures.name: Tannery Cur
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's (decision 0465): a loose cur from the tannery, all bark. Its barking can frighten a hero into cowering; settled, it slinks home.

creatures.name: Mink
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's (decision 0465): a mink off the millpond, quick and vicious. Dodges; worries a hero with three quick bites.

creatures.name: Floe
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's (decision 0465): a slab of race ice walked off the dam, the town's frost in a body. Slams down on one; the cold off it Chills everyone.

creatures.name: Loon
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's (decision 0465): a loon on the drowned town's lake, diving and calling. Its dive comes up from under the water, past any wall; its call frightens.

creatures.name: Fisher
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's (decision 0465): the Tanbark Road's fisher, on Tanner's Row, with its own level and numbers. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Frostheave
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's form, the base Lower Harlow's grows from (decision 0465): the Tanbark Road's frostheave a level or two on. No group fights it outside. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Mink
creatures._art: Lower Harlow's (decision 0465): the mink, tougher under the ice: 15% more health, 10% more bite than Harlow's. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Floe
creatures._art: Lower Harlow's (decision 0465): the floe, tougher under the ice: 15% more health, 10% more weight than Harlow's. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Loon
creatures._art: Lower Harlow's (decision 0465): the loon, tougher under the ice: 15% more health, 10% more bite than Harlow's. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Frostheave
creatures._art: Lower Harlow's (decision 0465): the drowned stretch of ring wall's stones, pushed up by the ice: 15% more health and 10% more weight than Harlow's frostheave. Same sheets.

creatures.name: Old Gran
creatures._art: Lower Harlow's optional hero (decision 0466): a pike the size of a rowboat in the Millpond Hole. Every third round she goes down, rings spread under one hero, and the round after she comes up under them; down, nobody can reach her. Defend takes at least half off it. Settled once, she goes down and stays down.

creatures.name: The Watcher
creatures._art: Harlow Bridge's (decision 0433): a great snowy owl from the cold side, on the gap stones of the ring wall for five years (decision 0430). Keeps its eyes on whoever struck it last. Never beaten: Thadeous's lullaby hushes it, and it sleeps on the wall after.
